source.locator: LP matrix lines 19-28; compare OLP-0386, OLP-0388 and OLP-0395

findings.finding: The source calls the language standard L_0 while listing only its four nonconstant connectives. It adopts the strong Kleene truth functions, for which the preceding Telugu edition explicitly restricts the language to the variable-generated four-connective fragment.
findings.required_translation_handling: State that LP uses this four-connective fragment, excluding the unstated falsity constant, and disclose the restriction adjacent to the matrix.

source.locator: Hallden matrix lines 30-48; compare OLP-0386, OLP-0388 and OLP-0395

findings.finding: The source again names standard L_0 but omits its falsity constant while adding a unary plus operator to the weak Kleene truth functions.
findings.required_translation_handling: Define the variable-generated four-connective fragment extended by plus, and disclose that this does not silently assign a value to the falsity constant.

findings.finding: After the matrix-language repair, equality of tautology sets with full classical L_0 is not literal because the latter contains a falsity constant absent from LP. The proof compares formulas in the common fragment.
findings.required_translation_handling: State equality only for the common variable-generated four-connective language and disclose the qualification beside the proposition.

findings.finding: The source equates the two evaluations for every variable even though its just-defined v-prime maps Undef to True. The induction needs only preservation of definite False and True values.
findings.required_translation_handling: Give each evaluation as its own assignment and prove the conditional False and True preservation claims; disclose the repair.

source.locator: LP conjunction induction false and true cases lines 105-119

findings.finding: Both conjunction cases repeat the B evaluation in the second condition where the C evaluation is required. The strong Kleene conjunction table and the subsequent induction conclusion both require B and C.
findings.required_translation_handling: Change only the duplicated second conjunct in both cases to C and disclose the two repairs as one finding.

source.locator: paragraph after Hallden tautology exercise lines 139-144

findings.finding: LP and Hallden share classical tautologies on their common four-connective fragment, but Hallden has an additional plus connective and hence a larger formula language. Literal equality of all formula sets is not well typed.
findings.required_translation_handling: Qualify the shared-tautologies statement to the common four-connective language and disclose that Hallden's extended language is not literally the same set.
